sources.title: Independent exact rotation and accounting derivation
sources.details:
Own mathematical derivation, completed before verdict; fixed Q/K content.
Let R(t)=[[cos(t),-sin(t)],[sin(t),cos(t)]]. Matrix columns are the rotated unit horizontal and vertical basis. R(t)[x,y]^T=[cos(t)x-sin(t)y,sin(t)x+cos(t)y]^T. cos²+sin²=1 makes R(t)^T R(t)=I, so squared length x²+y² is preserved.
For fixed q,k and angles aθ,bθ: (R(aθ)q)^T(R(bθ)k)=q^T R(aθ)^T R(bθ)k=q^T R((b-a)θ)k. Replacing a,b by a+s,b+s cancels s. With q=k=[1,0], this equals cos((b-a)θ). This is a real-number identity; float32 implementations agree within rounding tolerance.
θ=π/4=45°. b-a=5-2=15-12=25-22=3, hence135° and cos=-√2/2≈-0.7071067811865475, four decimals-0.7071. A common shift10 adds450° to each rotated vector. b-a=5-3=2 gives90°, cos=0 mathematically. b-a=26-22=4 gives180°, cos=-1. The two-dimensional lesson is periodic every8 positions; it is not claimed to uniquely encode arbitrarily large positions.
At45°, cos=sin=√2/2≈0.7071067811865475; at135° cos=-√2/2, sin=√2/2; at90° cos=0,sin=1. An angle in degrees timesπ/180 gives radians;180°→π and45°→π/4.
For an arbitrary d-dimensional standard RoPE with even d, pair j uses θ_j=10000^(-2j/d); sum the independent pair dot products. Orthogonality and shift cancellation hold pair by pair; each frequency is shared by Q and K for that pair. This does not preserve context-dependent Q/K after arbitrary re-encoding a longer sentence.
Parameters: two independent byte tables264×64=16,896 each; position table128×64=8,192. Each of two blocks has two LayerNorms(2×2×64=256), four bias-free attention matrices(4×64×64=16,384), and dense FFN64→256→64(64×256+256+256×64+64=33,088), total49,728. Final LayerNorm has128. Total=2×16,896+8,192+2×49,728+128=141,568. RoPE stores no learned rotation table and removes8,192, yielding133,376. CPU instantiation independently confirms all sizes.
For each story with B UTF8 bytes, [BOS]+B byte IDs+[EOS] has B+2 entries. Shifted next-token labels count B+1, including EOS once, excluding BOS. Window starts every128 share only the preceding input, not a target. Summed nonignored labels therefore equal sum(B+1). Story-level split counts for512 unique content families are floor(.8×512)=409, floor(.9×512)-409=51, remainder52. Actual family splitting and fingerprint equality were executed, not assumed.
Heldout sums/denominators: baseline validation88,848.587890625/39,256=2.2633123061602047; RoPE validation68,367.38330078125/39,256=1.7415779320557685; baseline test96,051.251953125/41,914=2.291626949303932; RoPE test74,528.04125976562/41,914=1.7781180813037558. Rounding to5 decimals gives precisely the four lesson values. NLL=-(sum log p(target))/target_count, so lower on these same targets means larger geometric mean target probability, not guaranteed grammatical generation or unseen-length quality.
